τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας follows rule 47 exactly: ἴδιος is itself a source word able to carry *their own*, so the article is unrepresented. Giving *their* to the article is the competing reading and is refused by rule 47 in terms.

καιρός is anarthrous, so the supplied *the* is a rule 7 helper on the noun under rule 51's anarthrous clause; τῆς ὑγιαινούσης διδασκαλίας splits into article, participle-adjective and noun under rule 26.
τὴν ἀκοήν is unrepresented under rule 23 because the ASV writes a bare plural *ears*; κατά keeps its own *after* under rule 36.
